title: A tree across the road
text: A big tree has come down across the road in the night, roots and all, and there's no way round for a cart.

success.text: You're over, with only bark on your hands.

fail.text: You slip on the wet trunk and bark your shin.

choices.label: Hack a way through the branches for the next cart (an hour)

effects.text: An hour's work, and the road is open. Someone will be glad of it.
Brambles and wet leaves, but you come out on the road beyond.
